multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: all 24 journey slices are integrated in every stage

checks.proves: Visit, checklist, evidence, escalation, geofence, conflict, and persistence behavior pass focused tests.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove mobile lifecycle or UI wording.
checks.passCriteria: All positive, forbidden, conflict, and idempotency cases pass.
checks.failCriteria: Any missing negative case or failure fails.

checks.doesNotProve: It cannot prove vendor-specific process death or real GPS.
checks.passCriteria: Tests include queue corruption, deduplication, reconnect, and unknown-result behavior.
checks.failCriteria: Any absent required case or failing assertion fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: execute MAN-05 through MAN-11 with network loss before send and after commit, process death, restart, reinstall, and assignment revocation
checks.proves: Offline evidence is retained, duplicate effects are prevented, and unknown results reconcile across surfaces.
checks.doesNotProve: Requires physical devices and controlled network conditions.
checks.passCriteria: All cases preserve evidence and converge without unauthorized replay.
checks.failCriteria: Any evidence loss, duplicate, false success, or stale scope fails.
